name: Exterior Aluminum Siding RP Self-Etching Primer
intent: Self-etching primer (phosphoric acid + zinc) ALWAYS required. DFT-critical: 0.5-1.0 mil max.
doctrine: Self-etching primer (phosphoric acid + zinc phosphate conversion). NOT STIX/adhesion primer (that's for vinyl). DFT-critical: 0.5-1.0 mil max — over-application causes cohesive failure within primer layer. Spray at 350 SF/hr (slower than vinyl 400 — requires careful DFT control). DFT verification mandatory.
